what_this_is: The nine-piece human sample's measurements, transcribed verbatim from openspec/style/blog-voice-calibration.md on 2026-08-30. NOT the prose: the sample was fetched during the original derivation and never committed, and the calibration record states that derivation did not keep the URLs. It also records that the single union fire is a chrome artifact of one particular fetch (the MIT Technology Review page's nav rail and 'Deep Dive' section label), so re-fetching would not reproduce it. What this file supports is a THRESHOLD regression test, not an instrument test, and lib/fixtures/README.md says so in those words.
